caption: The drawing features a metallic hanging scale composed of a circular dial or case with a flat face, which displays graduated markings on a yellowish background. Attached to the top of the dial is a large metal ring, used for hanging or holding the scale. A pair of metal hooks hang from the side and bottom of the dial: a smaller hook on the side, possibly for calibration or secondary attachment, and a larger S-shaped hook at the bottom for suspending objects to be weighed. The primary materials depicted appear metallic, with dark gray and brownish tones, combined with the yellowish-tan coloration of the dial face. The background is plain and light beige, and the only text present, located in the lower right corner, is a small inscription indicating the name "Edward Unger" with the date "1939."
title: Scale
